UC-1115.note: The helper card's state while it works, on the right of its first line: {time} is UC-1119 or UC-1120, read again each minute. New (the helper used to fold into the step group as UC-906).

UC-1116.note: The helper card's state once it is done: how long it took, in whole minutes. New.

UC-1117.note: The helper card's state once it failed, in the primary ink with the break, never red. New.

UC-1118.note: The helper card's state once it was stopped (the lawyer's Stop, or the agent quit under it). New.

UC-1119.note: {time} in UC-1115 to UC-1118 under a minute. No seconds tick. New.

UC-1120.note: {time} in UC-1115 to UC-1118 from a minute on, whole minutes. New.

UC-1121.note: A done helper's card when it reported nothing back. New.

UC-1122.en: It ended without reporting back to {agent}.
UC-1122.note: A failed helper's card when it gave no reason (the host closes a helper still open at the answer's end as failed). {agent}: Claude or ChatGPT. New.

UC-1123.note: A failed helper's card, under why it failed: what it did, in the step group's words ("2 papers read."). New.

UC-1124.note: A stopped helper's card: what it did before it was stopped, in the step group's words. New.

UC-1125.en: Waiting for a helper to finish.
UC-1125.note: The working line while the lead waits on one helper, in place of "Thinking it through." or the launching step's words. New.

UC-1126.note: The working line while the lead waits on two or more helpers. New.

UC-1127.note: The name on the card of Claude's paper-reader helper (Clauseo's own type). New.

UC-1128.note: The name on the card of Claude's researcher helper (Clauseo's own type). New.

UC-1129.note: The name on the card of a helper with no type, by its place among the conversation's unnamed helpers. New.
